segments.name: private aviation services
segments.description: Provides airplane sales and software-as-a-service subscriptions, with revenue derived primarily in North America.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, private aviation services, managed on a consolidated basis by the CEO who is the CODM.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for airplane sales and software-as-a-service subscriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: The private aviation services segment provides airplane sales and software-as-a-service subscriptions.

changes.text: In March 2025 the company sold GC Aviation, Inc., which held its FAA air carrier certificate.

changes.text: In September 2024 the company agreed to transition its aircraft ownership program fleet operations to flyExclusive.
